id.description: Orchestrator-owned UUID expectation identifier. Grading agents must ignore this field and must not populate or depend on it; the orchestrator adds it before writing grading.json.

passed.description: True when the available evidence satisfies the expectation. False when evidence is missing, contradictory, superficial, or insufficient.

evidence.description: The full analysis of the evidence supporting the verdict.

executive_summary.description: A substantive analysis of the grading results, highlighting key findings, failure modes and potential fixes to the observed behavior.

results.description: Structured grading results separated by whole-run expectations and turn-specific expectations.

overall_expectations.description: Results for every expectation listed in eval.outcome_expectations. Empty when the eval defines no outcome_expectations.

turns.description: Turn-specific grading results. Each item corresponds to one eval.turns[] entry that has expectations.

turn.description: One-based turn number from the eval run.

expectations.description: Results for every expectation listed on this turn in eval.turns[].expectations.
